modules.name: Mobile App – Society Manager
modules.description: The mobile app features for a Society Manager, who is also a resident and gets all Resident features.

modules.name: Resident Management
modules.description: Approving, adding, editing and deactivating owners and tenants.

modules.name: Complaint Management
modules.description: Checking, assigning, updating and tracking complaints in the project.

modules.name: Bookings and Facilities
modules.description: Approving hall bookings and closing facilities for maintenance.

modules.name: Notice Board
modules.description: Notice Board posts and the project contact directory.

modules.name: Visitor and Family Summaries
modules.description: Visitor records, project summary and family and member summaries.

requirements.title: Society Manager gets all Resident features
requirements.description: A Society Manager is also a resident and gets all Resident features in addition to the manager features.

requirements.title: Approve or reject owners and tenants
requirements.description: A Society Manager can approve or reject owners and tenants.

requirements.title: Add a resident manually
requirements.description: A Society Manager can add a resident manually.

requirements.title: Edit or deactivate resident; confirm tenancy end
requirements.description: A Society Manager can edit or deactivate a resident and confirm the end of a tenancy.

requirements.title: Check if a complaint is genuine
requirements.description: A Society Manager can check whether a complaint is genuine.

requirements.title: Assign society-responsibility complaints
requirements.description: A Society Manager can assign complaints that are the society's responsibility.

requirements.title: Update complaint status for society vendors
requirements.description: A Society Manager can update complaint status for society vendors.

requirements.title: Track all complaints in the project
requirements.description: A Society Manager can track all complaints in the project.

requirements.title: Manage society documents
requirements.description: A Society Manager can manage society documents.

requirements.title: Approve hall bookings
requirements.description: A Society Manager can approve hall bookings.

requirements.title: Close a facility for maintenance
requirements.description: A Society Manager can close a facility for maintenance.

requirements.title: Notice Board posts for own project
requirements.description: A Society Manager can post notices on the Notice Board for their own project.

requirements.title: Project contact directory
requirements.description: A Society Manager can use the project contact directory.

requirements.title: Create or remove a Watchman
requirements.description: A Society Manager can create or remove a Watchman.

requirements.title: Visitor record and project summary
requirements.description: A Society Manager can view the visitor record and project summary.

requirements.title: Family and member summary by building
requirements.description: A Society Manager can view a family and member summary, owners vs tenants, by building.

rules.title: Resident approval features need Approve residents
rules.description: Approving or rejecting residents, adding a resident manually, and editing or deactivating a resident or confirming tenancy end need the Approve residents permission.

rules.title: Complaint checking needs Check complaints
rules.description: Checking if a complaint is genuine and tracking all complaints in the project need the Check complaints permission.

rules.title: Complaint assignment needs Assign society complaints
rules.description: Assigning society-responsibility complaints and updating complaint status for society vendors need the Assign society complaints permission.

rules.title: Documents need Manage documents permission
rules.description: Managing society documents needs the Manage documents permission.

rules.title: Bookings need Approve bookings permission
rules.description: Approving hall bookings and closing a facility for maintenance need the Approve bookings permission.

rules.title: Notices and directory need Post notices
rules.description: Notice Board posts for own project and the project contact directory need the Post notices permission.

rules.title: Watchman management needs Manage watchmen
rules.description: Creating or removing a Watchman needs the Manage watchmen permission.

rules.title: Visitor record and project summary need no specific permission
rules.description: The visitor record and project summary are available under any permission.

rules.title: Family summary needs View family data
rules.description: The family and member summary by building needs the View family data permission.
